steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Safe dance practice protects dancers from injury and supports long-term health and performance | Key Fact: A warm-up gradually raises the heart rate, increases blood flow to muscles and prepares the body for dance | Key Fact: An effective warm-up includes pulse-raising activities, joint mobilisation, dynamic stretching and dance-specific movements | Key Fact: A cool-down gradually returns the body to a resting state and helps prevent stiffness and soreness

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from safe dance practice, and one past-paper question.
